spindle.observe.AnswerSource.title: AnswerSource
spindle.observe.AnswerSource.description: What answered one external cause of a served command. `world`: the `decisions` of the world the last reset loaded, `spindle.console.World`. `file`: the decisions file. `default`: the default branch `--answer-default` takes. `call`: the HTTP call the environment binds the cause to (`[http.<name>]`). `unanswered`: nothing did, or the cause's HTTP call failed, and the command answered `501`. Source: `crates/spindle-cli/src/decisions.rs:47-71`, `crates/spindle-ingress/src/observe.rs:186-213`.
